title: Scalable Rule Lists Learning with Sampling

problem.claim: Finding optimal rule lists is computationally challenging.

gap.claim: Current approaches are impractical for large datasets.

narrative_sequence.summary: Interpretable models are increasingly important in socially consequential machine learning.
Rule lists are presented as well-known and easily interpretable models.
Optimal rule-list learning is computationally difficult, and existing approaches do not scale well to large datasets.

source_observation.claim: Optimal rule-list learning is computationally challenging, and current approaches are impractical for large datasets.

interpretation.claim: Interpretability alone does not ensure computational scalability.

application.claim: When deploying interpretable models on large datasets, assess the computational feasibility of the learning procedure.
